In the present case, the Petitioner is a transmission licensee, who is already implementing the project defined under its scope under the RTM mechanism. The present Petition is consequent to the office order 28.10.2021 notified by the Ministry of Power Government of India wherein CTUIL has been authorized to determine the mode of implementation of ISTS projects costing up to Rs. 100 crores. Pursuant to the direction of the Ministry of Power, CTUIL, vide its Office Memorandums dated 26.10.2023 and 18.7.2024 and recommendation letter dated 7.11.2024, has determined a list of Projects to be implemented through a Regulated Tariff Mechanism, which also includes the subject transmission system under the instant Petition.
